instruction: Create a new one-storey apartment model in Bonsai with assigned materials, then save result.ifc and export an IFC data schedule as result.csv. Start from a blank project; no local reference images are provided. Use an IFC4 model and a Bonsai or IfcCSV-style workflow for the schedule export. The IFC model should have one project and one building storey named Level 00. Include exactly four spaces named Living, Kitchen, Bedroom, and Bath; seven walls; three doors; four windows; one slab; and no building element proxies. Assign every wall the ordered material layer sequence Brick, Insulation, Gypsum. Assign every door the material Timber and every window the material Aluminium. The CSV must have the exact header order GlobalId, Class, TypeName, MaterialSummary, Storey. It should contain exactly 14 non-empty data rows, one for each wall, door, and window in result.ifc, matched by GlobalId without missing or extra elements. The Class counts should be IfcWall 7, IfcDoor 3, and IfcWindow 4. MaterialSummary should be Brick | Insulation | Gypsum for the seven walls, Timber for the three doors, and Aluminium for the four windows. Every row should list Storey as Level 00. Other details may vary.
